name: Rumble Pro Wrestling World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top prize, first won by Justin Kell in a match the surviving broadcasts only recall, and held by him through the last card the newsgroup carries.

name: Rumble Pro Wrestling Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own tag prize, first won by Real Xtreme in the final of a one-night, nine-team tournament at Initiation Rites, 10 April 2004.
